rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_supervised-claude-agentic: proj_n_bf=2, img_n_bf=3, proj_kernel=3, proj_sx=0.01, proj_sy=0.3, proj_sr=0.0005, img_kernel=5, img_sx=0.5, img_sy=0.5, img_sr=0.02, lr=0.005, epochs=24, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, lambda_neg=1.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-4 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). BASE = the iter-2 BEST config (proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, 12 params, hr 0.0282) -- NOT iter-3's regressed img_n_bf=6 (which collapsed hr to 0.0). ONE KNOB: proj_n_bf 1->2 (projection-domain bilateral DEPTH -- the UNTRIED domain). params 3*(proj_n_bf+img_n_bf) = 3*(2+3) = 15 (up from iter-2's 12; iter-3's image-domain bump went to 21 and REGRESSED). epochs KEPT at 24 (proven inert iter-1->iter-2), img_n_bf KEPT at 3 (the iter-2 best, NOT iter-3's 6), all sigmas/kernels/lr/grad_clip identical to iter-2. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) iter-1 SSIM 0.919181 hr 0.027984 in 254.3s @ ep8, 12 params (params_M 1.2e-05); iter-2 SSIM 0.919155 hr 0.028237 in 449.6s @ ep24, 12 params -- the BEST; FLAT vs iter-1 (epochs INERT, +0.0003 = noise); iter-3 SSIM 0.905690 hr 0.0 in 574.3s @ img_n_bf=6, 21 params -- REGRESSED (image-domain capacity++ DESTABILIZED, hr collapsed 0.0282->0.0). (2) FAILURE MODE: few-param dual-domain trainable-bilateral at a CAPACITY CEILING (~hr 0.028) on the 2304-view Mayo FBP. Two levers are SPENT: epochs is inert (iter-1->iter-2 flat), and image-domain capacity-up HURTS (iter-3 regressed to 0). The remaining UNTRIED lever is the OTHER domain -- the projection-domain bilateral, which has been FROZEN at proj_n_bf=1 for all 3 prior iters. (3) ONE KNOB = proj_n_bf 1->2. JUSTIFICATION vs the other iter-4 candidate (img_kernel 5->7, named by iter-3's falsifier): img_kernel-up adds IMAGE-domain smoothing/receptive-field -- the SAME domain whose capacity bump (img_n_bf 3->6) just REGRESSED hr to 0.0 in iter-3 -- so it probes the proven-harmful direction. proj_n_bf-up instead attacks the genuinely untested projection domain: a 2nd sinogram-domain bilateral cleans correlated projection noise BEFORE the 2304-view FBP adjoint amplifies it, a fundamentally different denoising locus than the post-FBP image domain. This is the cleaner falsification of iter-3's structural-ceiling claim (does ANY domain's capacity move hr, or only image-domain that destabilizes?). PARAM COUNT: 12->15 (+3, one extra 3-param bilateral) -- a MODEST add, far below iter-3's 21 that regressed; the image domain stays at the iter-2 best img_n_bf=3 so the image-domain instability is NOT re-triggered. (4) HYPOTHESIS: a 2nd projection-domain bilateral (15 vs 12 params) lifts hr above 0.028237 because cleaning sinogram noise pre-FBP attacks the noise where the FBP adjoint has not yet correlated/amplified it -- a locus the inert epochs and the destabilizing image-domain depth could not reach. FALSIFIER: if hr stays <=0.029 (flat or regression at proj_n_bf=2), the dual-domain trainable-bilateral is STRUCTURALLY capped on Mayo regardless of WHICH domain's capacity is increased (image-domain regressed in iter-3, projection-domain inert here) -> FILE THE CEILING VERDICT: the ~hr 0.028 ceiling is the few-param-bilateral structural limit on real 2304-view Mayo LDCT, and no within-architecture knob escapes it. (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score. iter-2 @ ep24, 12 params ran in 449.6s; per-step cost is dominated by the SHARED 2304-view FBP adjoint, NOT the bilateral params, so adding ONE projection-domain BF (1->2) costs only one extra cheap sinogram-bilateral pass per step -> est ~460-520s, comfortably <1200s. val_n=214 KEPT (do NOT reduce), grad_clip=1.0 KEPT, epochs=24 KEPT. sbatch --time=00:30:00 = SLURM safety net above the 20-min metric-validity budget. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (mayo_per_sample_setup/_fbp, per-sample pipe.R_full swap), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override).
